mapper.insert: INSERT INTO flow_comment (instance_id, task_id, user_id, username, action, content) VALUES (#{instanceId}, #{taskId}, #{userId}, #{username}, #{action}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, instance_id, task_id, user_id, username, action, content, create_time FROM flow_comment WHERE instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY comment_id ASC
